outcome: Rate of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
Rate of primary elective repeat cesarean section
Rate of secondary repeat cesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women with previous cesarean sections who gave birth in a tertiary care referral hospital in Switzerland or were included in the annual statistics of Swiss Women's Hospitals (ASF-Statistics) in two time periods (1998/1999 and 2004/2005)
finding: Vaginal birth after a prior cesarean section decreased significantly in Switzerland between 1998/1999 and 2004/2005, while primary elective repeat cesarean sections increased.
mod_finding: The study found a significant decrease in vaginal births after cesarean section (VBAC) over time in Switzerland.
